summary: Triggers up to four wheel-rotation audio effects for a driver. Requires all four audio-source handles at this+0x20..0x2C to be non-null and one of the two activity flags at dword_7C54E0+3984 / +3964 to be non-zero; then reads a driver appearance bitmask via sub_49B7A0(&unk_7CE234) and calls AudioEffectTrigger once per wheel (bits 0..3 of the bitmask) with the corresponding handle. Called by SteeringWheelAnimation.

operations.description: Early return unless this[8] (audio source handle at +0x20) is non-null.
Early return unless this[9] (audio source handle at +0x24) is non-null.
Early return unless this[10] (audio source handle at +0x28) is non-null.
Early return unless this[11] (audio source handle at +0x2C) is non-null.
Block audio unless one of the two activity flags at dword_7C54E0+3984 or dword_7C54E0+3964 is non-zero (wheels spinning/moving).
Read the driver appearance bitmask: bitmask = sub_49B7A0(&unk_7CE234).
Wheel 3: return AudioEffectTrigger((bitmask >> 3) & 1, this[11]); its result is the function return value.
Any early-exit path returns the last propagated result (a null handle, or dword_7C54E0 when the activity-flag guard fails).
